renderer: native WebGLRenderer / WebGL2, no WebGPU or software-renderer substitution
cache: Fresh browser context per primary repetition; one warm reload recorded separately. OS and GPU driver caches are not controlled. Alternating order reduces order bias.
measurement: Real browser rAF intervals, long tasks and public performance/loading JSON. Resource counts are not bytes. Heap is optional Chromium JS heap; process/GPU memory and physical thermal state are not inferred.

required: desktop and actual iPhone Safari pass

interpretation: Explore three repetitions per arm, not a population estimate. Report each raw run and order, medians/ranges and paired differences. Defer adoption while device evidence, compatible typings or critical validation remains incomplete. Separate engine/type-only migration changes from any application fix. No automatic production merge.
